faqs.q: Does IRCTC HDFC Bank Credit Card offer an annual fee waiver?
faqs.a: Yes, IRCTC HDFC Bank Credit Card charges an annual fee of Rs. 500. You can avail annual fee waiver by spending Rs. 1.5 Lakh in a year.

faqs.q: What is the eligibility criteria for IRCTC HDFC Credit Card?
faqs.a: To apply for this credit card, your age must be between 21 and 65 years. Besides this, if you are a salaried individual, you must have a monthly income of Rs. 15,000. For self-employed individuals, the annual income requirement is Rs. 6 LPA.

faqs.q: Does IRCTC HDFC Bank Credit Card offer a transaction charge waiver for train ticket bookings?
faqs.a: Yes, you can avail 1% transaction charge waiver for ticket bookings made through the IRCTC website and app. The maximum waiver you can avail in a month is Rs. 1,000.

faqs.q: How can I apply for IRCTC HDFC Credit Card?
faqs.a: You can apply for this card online by visiting the official website of HDFC Bank and navigating to the card page. You are required to fill out the application form and attach all the relevant documents while applying for the card. If you wish to apply offline, you can visit the nearest HDFC Bank branch and submit the application form in person.

faqs.q: Can I earn reward points on UPI spends with IRCTC HDFC Bank Credit Card?
faqs.a: Yes, IRCTC HDFC Bank Credit Card is also available on the RuPay network. Therefore, you can link this credit card to a UPI app and earn rewards on UPI spends as well.

faqs.q: Does IRCTC HDFC Credit Card offer lounge access benefits?
faqs.a: Yes, HDFC Bank Credit Card offers 8 complimentary visits to select IRCTC Executive Lounges every year, with a maximum of 2 visits per quarter.

faqs.question: Is the IRCTC HDFC Bank Credit Card worth it?
faqs.answer: If you book train tickets regularly, yes. The card offers strong rewards on IRCTC bookings, railway lounge access and rewards on RuPay UPI spends.

faqs.question: How much can I save on train ticket bookings with the IRCTC HDFC Bank Credit Card?
faqs.answer: You earn 5 Reward Points per ₹100 spent on IRCTC bookings. HDFC also offers an additional 5% cashback on eligible train bookings made through SmartBuy.

faqs.question: How many railway lounge visits are offered?
faqs.answer: You get 8 complimentary railway lounge visits every year, limited to 2 visits per quarter.

faqs.question: Does the card earn rewards on UPI payments?
faqs.answer: Yes. Eligible RuPay UPI transactions earn 1 Reward Point per ₹100 spent.
